purpose: Defines the implementation strategy document and its general principles, for use when no project-specific rules exist, covering its responsibility, boundary with plans, and handling of additive development.
summary: Definition of the implementation strategy document: responsibility, lifespan, file name
Dependence of strategy on design: existing-code handling follows from the design
What the strategy does not write: structure design and individual task units
Boundary with the plan: phase-order versus task executability
Phase order is converted to task priority in the plan
Additive development difficulty: conflicting, newly added, subtly changed existing items
No rule table for choosing modify versus rewrite; avoid inertia
Strategy is checked against existing code, not old specification documents
Constraints received from the additive development specification sections
tasks: Deciding how to treat existing code against a new design
Splitting work between strategy and plan
title: 実装戦略書 作成原則
